Expert physical therapy tips, injury recovery guides, and at-home exercises from Highbar Physical Therapy — a physical therapist–owned practice with 25+ clinics across Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts.

On this channel, our licensed PTs break down what's actually causing your pain and what to do about it:
• Knee pain, back pain, shoulder injuries, ankle sprains
• Post-surgical recovery (ACL, knee replacement, rotator cuff)
• Dry needling, manual therapy & what they actually do
• Return-to-sport for runners, golfers, lifters & weekend warriors
• Home exercise programs that actually work
• Honest answers to the questions patients ask us every day

▶️ NEW VIDEOS WEEKLY — subscribe so you don't miss them.

📍 Book an appointment at any of our 25+ Highbar clinics: https://www.highbarhealth.com

Specialties: Spine | Sports | Orthopedic | Post-Surgical | Dry Needling | Running | Pelvic Health | Pediatrics
